lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with clusters showing a decreasing size gradient toward the dorsal surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with light-reflecting upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, discrete high-luminance blobs are sparsely distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the anterior and central regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin, approximately midway between the apex and the insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of minute high-luminance points along the leading edge, transitioning to larger and more widely spaced circular clusters toward the trailing margin.
